```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
})

# -----------------------------
# 0) Input LDSC results
# -----------------------------
infile <- "/wynton/group/andrews/users/rakshyasharma/PRS/genetic_correlations/ldsc/20260116/all_results_ldsc.tsv"
df <- read_tsv(infile, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    z = as.numeric(z),
    p = as.numeric(p)
  )

# -----------------------------
# 1) Identify rows (edit patterns if filenames change)
# -----------------------------
edu_id <- function(x) case_when(
  str_detect(x, "Okbay2022educ") ~ "Okbay2022educ",
  str_detect(x, "NealeEdu2018")  ~ "NealeEdu2018",
  str_detect(x, "NealeEduFemale2018") ~ "NealeEduFemale2018",
  str_detect(x, "NealeEduMale2018")   ~ "NealeEduMale2018",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

outcome_id <- function(x) case_when(
  str_detect(x, "Belloy2024FinnGensexhet") ~ "Belloy2024FinnGensexhet",
  str_detect(x, "Belloy2024FinnGenfemales") ~ "Belloy2024FinnGenfemales",
  str_detect(x, "Belloy2024FinnGenmales")   ~ "Belloy2024FinnGenmales",
  str_detect(x, "Belloy2024UKBBsexhet")     ~ "Belloy2024UKBBsexhet",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    edu     = edu_id(p1),
    outcome = outcome_id(p2)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(edu), !is.na(outcome))

# -----------------------------
# 2) Provide sample sizes (N_eff) you want to use for scaling
#    For Option D, we just need N_eff, and we assume z ∝ sqrt(N_eff).
#
#    A simple choice: N_eff = N_edu * N_ad
#    (This makes scaling work even if you later use sex-specific education GWAS.)
# -----------------------------
n_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~id,                         ~N,
  "Okbay2022educ",             3037499,
  "NealeEdu2018",               357549,
  "NealeEduFemale2018",         192300,
  "NealeEduMale2018",           165249,

  "Belloy2024FinnGensexhet",    530869,
  "Belloy2024FinnGenfemales",   300237,
  "Belloy2024FinnGenmales",     230632,

  "Belloy2024UKBBsexhet",       774898
)

# -----------------------------
# 3) Pull "combined" z (sexhet) for each education GWAS (FinnGen)
# -----------------------------
edu_for_power <- c("Okbay2022educ", "NealeEdu2018")

combined_tbl <- df2 %>%
  filter(edu %in% edu_for_power,
         outcome == "Belloy2024FinnGensexhet") %>%
  select(edu, z_combined = z, p_combined = p)

# -----------------------------
# 4) Build target sex-strat rows (FinnGen Female/Male AD)
# -----------------------------
sex_tbl <- tibble::tribble(
  ~ad_outcome,                  ~sex,
  "Belloy2024FinnGenfemales",   "Female",
  "Belloy2024FinnGenmales",     "Male"
)

# -----------------------------
# 5) Option D implementation: predict z by N_eff scaling
#    z_pred = z_combined * sqrt(N_eff_sex / N_eff_combined)
#    where N_eff = N_edu * N_ad
# -----------------------------
getN <- function(id) n_map$N[match(id, n_map$id)]

alpha_nominal <- 0.05
zcrit <- qnorm(1 - alpha_nominal/2)

# "Power" from expected z (mu) without SE:
power_from_mu <- function(mu, alpha = 0.05){
  zc <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  (1 - pnorm(zc - mu)) + pnorm(-zc - mu)
}

pred_tbl <- tidyr::crossing(
  tibble(edu = edu_for_power),
  sex_tbl
) %>%
  left_join(combined_tbl, by = "edu") %>%
  mutate(
    N_edu = getN(edu),
    N_ad_combined = getN("Belloy2024FinnGensexhet"),
    N_ad_sex = getN(ad_outcome),

    # N_eff definition for scaling
    N_eff_combined = N_edu * N_ad_combined,
    N_eff_sex      = N_edu * N_ad_sex,

    scale_factor = sqrt(N_eff_sex / N_eff_combined),

    z_pred = z_combined * scale_factor,

    # predicted two-sided p-value from z_pred
    p_pred = 2 * pnorm(-abs(z_pred)),

    # optional: "predicted power" treating z_pred as mean under H1
    power_pred_alpha05 = power_from_mu(mu = z_pred, alpha = alpha_nominal)
  ) %>%
  arrange(edu, sex)

# Optional Bonferroni (across the predicted sex tests)
alpha_bonf <- 0.05 / nrow(pred_tbl)
pred_tbl <- pred_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    power_pred_bonf = power_from_mu(mu = z_pred, alpha = alpha_bonf)
  )

write_tsv(pred_tbl, "z_scaled_sexstrat_from_combined.tsv")

print(pred_tbl %>% select(
  edu, sex,
  z_combined, p_combined,
  scale_factor, z_pred, p_pred,
  power_pred_alpha05, power_pred_bonf
))

cat("\nSaved: z_scaled_sexstrat_from_combined.tsv\n")
cat("Bonferroni alpha used:", signif(alpha_bonf, 3), "\n")

```

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

pred <- read_tsv("z_scaled_sexstrat_from_combined.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    edu_label = case_when(
      edu == "Okbay2022educ"      ~ "Okbay 2022",
      edu == "NealeEdu2018"       ~ "Neale 2018",
      TRUE ~ edu
    ),
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )

# Power from expected z under H1 (no SE)
power_from_mu <- function(mu, alpha = 0.05) {
  zc <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)
  (1 - pnorm(zc - mu)) + pnorm(-zc - mu)
}

alpha_nominal <- 0.05
m_bonf <- nrow(pred)                 # same family as your predicted sex tests
alpha_bonf <- 0.05 / m_bonf

# Scale the combined effect up/down (relative to observed combined z)
mult_grid <- seq(0.5, 1.5, by = 0.05)

curve_df <- pred %>%
  tidyr::crossing(mult = mult_grid) %>%
  mutate(
    z_pred_scaled = z_pred * mult,
    power_nominal = power_from_mu(z_pred_scaled, alpha = alpha_nominal),
    power_bonf    = power_from_mu(z_pred_scaled, alpha = alpha_bonf)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(power_nominal, power_bonf),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "power") %>%
  mutate(
    alpha = ifelse(metric == "power_nominal", "Nominal (α=0.05)", "Bonferroni"),
    alpha = factor(alpha, levels = c("Nominal (α=0.05)", "Bonferroni"))
  )

p_curve <- ggplot(curve_df, aes(x = mult, y = power, linetype = alpha)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  facet_grid(sex ~ edu_label) +
  labs(
    x = "Multiplier on combined effect (1.0 = observed combined effect)",
    y = "Predicted power",
    title = "Power sensitivity to plausible effect-size attenuation",
    subtitle = "Scaling; dashed line indicates 80% power"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave("power_curves__effect_multiplier.png", p_curve, width = 11.5, height = 6.2, dpi = 300)
print(p_curve)
```

```{r}
# --------------------------------
# Minimum detectable z for 80% power
# --------------------------------

find_mu_for_power <- function(target_power = 0.80, alpha = 0.05){
  f <- function(mu){
    power_from_mu(mu, alpha) - target_power
  }
  uniroot(f, c(0, 10))$root
}

z_needed_nominal <- find_mu_for_power(0.80, alpha_nominal)
z_needed_bonf <- find_mu_for_power(0.80, alpha_bonf)

cat("Z needed for 80% power (nominal):", z_needed_nominal, "\n")
cat("Z needed for 80% power (Bonferroni):", z_needed_bonf, "\n")
```
